alt: A 3D graphic showing an orange-gradient logo shape and a blue logo assembly containing a white letter T on a light blue surface.
caption: Three-dimensional abstract logos and a letter T rest on a pale background with wavy lines.
description: A 3D illustration displays two distinct logo-style shapes resting on a pale blue surface scattered with small dots. On the left is a vibrant shape with a gradient of orange and yellow, accompanied by a pink sphere. To the right, a textured blue logo assembly features a white letter T inside a central square, surrounded by abstract circular forms and background waves.
